description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application runtime from Java 8 / Spring Boot 2.7.18 to Java 25 / Spring Boot 4.x, including Spring Framework 7.x and Jakarta EE namespace migration.
tasks.reason: Assessment findings azure-java-version-02000 (Java 8 is legacy and end-of-life), spring-boot-to-azure-spring-boot-version-01000 (Spring Boot 2.7.18 is end-of-life), and spring-framework-version-01000 (Spring Framework is end-of-life) are all mandatory violations. Per Acme Corp charter.md, Java 8, 11, and 17 are end-of-life for internal use and Spring Boot 2.x must be upgraded. Per targets.md, the required target versions are Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.x.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade pom.xml to use Spring Boot 4.x as the parent POM and set Java 25 as the compiler source and target. Migrate all javax.* imports to jakarta.* namespace throughout the codebase (Jakarta EE migration). Update all Spring Boot managed dependencies to 4.x compatible versions. Ensure Maven 3.9+ is used. All existing unit tests must pass after the upgrade. This task is a prerequisite for all subsequent transform and security tasks.

tasks.description: Replace all RestTemplate usage with the ServiceMesh SDK (com.acme.mesh.ServiceMesh) for all service-to-service HTTP communication.
tasks.reason: RestTemplate is a prohibited technology per Acme Corp policies.md because it bypasses the mesh layer that provides automatic circuit breaking, mTLS termination, distributed tracing, and canary routing. Per targets.md, all service-to-service communication must use ServiceMesh SDK.
tasks.requirements: Remove the RestTemplate bean from AppConfig.java and replace all RestTemplate usages in BackendApiService.java, InventoryApiService.java, and VendorApiService.java with equivalent ServiceMesh SDK (com.acme.mesh.ServiceMesh) calls. Update pom.xml to add the ServiceMesh SDK dependency. Maintain the same HTTP operations (GET, POST) and request/response mapping behavior. No hardcoded URLs should be introduced; use the existing property injection pattern.

tasks.description: Replace all SLF4J (@Slf4j) and System.out.println usage with InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger).
tasks.reason: SLF4J (@Slf4j, LoggerFactory), Logback, java.util.logging, System.out.println, and System.err.println are all prohibited technologies per Acme Corp policies.md because they have no trace-context integration. All logging must use InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger), which injects trace IDs, team tags, and structured JSON. Removing the System.out.println('Access at: http://localhost:8081') statement also resolves the mandatory AppCAT findings localhost-http-00001 and unsecure-network-protocol-00000 in SupplyChainFrontendApplication.java.
tasks.requirements: Replace all @Slf4j annotations in BackendApiService.java, InventoryApiService.java, and VendorApiService.java, and all System.out.println calls in SupplyChainFrontendApplication.java, with InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger). Update pom.xml to add the InternalLogger dependency and remove any direct SLF4J or Logback dependencies that are no longer required. Preserve existing log messages and severity levels where applicable.

tasks.description: Migrate user-facing authentication from legacy session-based authentication to Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) using OAuth 2.0 / OIDC.
tasks.reason: All user-facing authentication must use Azure AD with OAuth 2.0 / OIDC per Acme Corp policies.md. Legacy JAAS and LDAP authentication must be migrated as part of modernization. Per targets.md, Azure AD (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC) is the required authentication service for user-facing applications. The application's own code comments confirm that session-based auth must be migrated to Azure AD with OAuth 2.0.
tasks.requirements: Add Spring Cloud Azure Active Directory starter (spring-cloud-azure-starter-active-directory) and spring-boot-starter-oauth2-client dependencies. Configure Azure AD authentication properties in application configuration using Azure Key Vault references for sensitive values (client ID, client secret, tenant ID). Ensure all secured endpoints require authenticated users. Integrate the authentication flow with the Azure AD tenant using OAuth 2.0 / OIDC. Remove any legacy session-based or form-based authentication configuration.

tasks.description: Externalize all hardcoded connection strings and sensitive configuration values from application.yml and source code to Azure Key Vault.
tasks.reason: Hardcoded URLs and connection strings in application.yml (backend.api.url: http://backend:8080/api) are flagged as mandatory AppCAT findings hardcoded-urls-00001 and unsecure-network-protocol-00000. Per Acme Corp policies.md, hardcoded credentials in application.yml, application.properties, environment variables, or source code are a prohibited pattern; all sensitive values must be stored in Azure Key Vault. Per targets.md, Azure Key Vault is the required service for storing credentials, API keys, and connection strings. Azure Key Vault is also a required element in every modernized application per policies.md.
tasks.requirements: Add the Spring Cloud Azure Key Vault starter dependency to pom.xml. Configure the Spring Cloud Azure Key Vault property source to retrieve secrets from Azure Key Vault using Managed Identity (no client secrets in configuration files). Move the hardcoded backend.api.url value from application.yml to Azure Key Vault as a secret. Update application.yml to reference the Key Vault secret name via Spring Cloud Azure property source syntax. Ensure no credentials, API keys, connection strings, or sensitive URLs remain hardcoded in source code or configuration files after this task.

tasks.description: Validate and fix all CVE vulnerabilities in project Maven dependencies to ensure no known security vulnerabilities remain before containerization and deployment.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested that all CVE issues be fixed as part of this modernization. The legacy Java 8 / Spring Boot 2.7.18 dependency tree is likely to carry known CVEs in outdated transitive dependencies. These must be fully remediated before the application is containerized and deployed to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Scan all Maven dependencies for known CVEs and update or replace affected packages with safe, compatible versions. No high or critical CVE vulnerabilities should remain in any direct or transitive dependency after remediation. All updates must be compatible with Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.x. The project must still build and pass tests after all dependency updates.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Java 25 runtime and Maven 3.9+ build tool, established by task 001-upgrade-spring-boot-4x.

tasks.description: Update the Dockerfile to containerize the application for Azure Container Apps deployment using Java 25 multi-stage images.
tasks.reason: The existing Dockerfile uses outdated Java 8 base images (maven:3.8-openjdk-8 and tomcat:8.5-jdk8). Azure Container Apps deployment requires a container image built with the Java 25 runtime. Per targets.md, the build stage must use mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu and the runtime stage must use mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless.
tasks.requirements: Update the existing Dockerfile at the project root to use a multi-stage build: build stage with mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu and Maven 3.9+, runtime stage with mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless. Package the application as an executable JAR suitable for running with java -jar in a distroless container (update pom.xml packaging if needed). Ensure the EXPOSE port matches the server.port in application configuration. The image must run as a non-root user.

tasks.description: Deploy the containerized SupplyChain Frontend to Azure Container Apps (ACA) using Bicep IaC.
tasks.reason: Per Acme Corp charter.md, the default modernization strategy for all Java services in the supply chain system is to replatform to Azure Container Apps (ACA). The user requested migration to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Generate Bicep IaC files to provision the Azure Container Apps environment and deploy the containerized application. Configure the container app with appropriate CPU and memory resource allocations, environment variable references to Azure Key Vault secrets, and HTTPS ingress. Enable system-assigned Managed Identity for the container app and grant it access to Azure Key Vault. Configure the container registry for image storage. Ensure TLS 1.2+ is enforced for all ingress traffic.
